source_quotes.n_subjects: This study used adult (7–9 weeks) male C57BL/6N mice randomly assigned to four groups (n=8): NC (normal control), SD (sleep deprivation), SH (sham treatment), and US (ultrasound stimulation).
source_quotes.randomised: This study used adult (7–9 weeks) male C57BL/6N mice randomly assigned to four groups (n=8): NC (normal control), SD (sleep deprivation), SH (sham treatment), and US (ultrasound stimulation).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Mice were subjected to 20 hours of sleep deprivation, while receiving 10 minutes of TUS of the basal forebrain for 7 days.
source_quotes.sham_type: the SH group received identical anesthesia and transducer placement procedures as the US group, with the ultrasound stimulation system deactivated to control for the potential effects of anesthesia, handling, and transducer placement.
source_quotes.exposures[0].target.label: The ultrasound transducer was coupled to the intact scalp using ultrasound gel, with the focal region targeting the bilateral medial basal forebrain $( \mathrm { A P } = + 0 . 2 4$ mm, ML = ±0.25 mm, DV = −5.00 mm relative to bregma), a key region involved in sleep– wake regulation, REM sleep, and cognitive function.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The ultrasound was generated by a small 1 MHz focused transducer.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: The negative peak pressure before transcranial application was 0.27 MPa, corresponding to a mechanical index (MI) of 0.27.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: A pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 250 Hz and a pulse duration (PD) of 2 ms were used, corresponding to a duty cycle of 50%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: A pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 250 Hz and a pulse duration (PD) of 2 ms were used, corresponding to a duty cycle of 50%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: A pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 250 Hz and a pulse duration (PD) of 2 ms were used, corresponding to a duty cycle of 50%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The total sonication duration (TSD) was 200 ms, with an inter-stimulation interval (ISI) of 5 s.
source_quotes.anaesthesia: Mice receiving induction of anesthesia were placed in a home-made plexiglas inhalation anesthesia box using 2% isoflurane (Shenzhen Ruiwode Life Technology Co., Ltd, Beijing, China) delivered by oxygen at a rate of 0.4 L/min.

flags.reason: Main group-design statement gives n=8 per group, but several figure legends report smaller subsample sizes for specific assays (e.g., n=5 for EEG/behaviour, n=3 for cortisol); n=8 (the ultrasound-stimulated US group) is used here.
The transducer is described only as 'a small 1 MHz focused transducer' with no manufacturer or model given.
Only negative peak pressure and mechanical index are reported; no ISPPA/ISPTA intensity values are given.

readout_other: Y-maze spontaneous alternation; open field test; Nissl staining of hippocampal neuron counts; c-Fos immunofluorescence; serum cortisol ELISA
direction_notes: TUS of the basal forebrain increased c-Fos expression (neuronal activation marker) in the BF, increased REM sleep percentage and NREM delta / REM theta power toward or above normal-control levels, and improved cognitive/behavioural and cortisol measures relative to sleep-deprived mice.

exposures.label: TUS of the bilateral medial basal forebrain in sleep-deprived mice

target.label: bilateral medial basal forebrain (AP = +0.24 mm, ML = ±0.25 mm, DV = -5.00 mm relative to bregma)

timing.protocol_description: The total sonication duration (TSD) was 200 ms, with an inter-stimulation interval (ISI) of 5 s. The US group received ultrasound stimulation for 10 min per day while the mice were sleep deprived, for 7 consecutive days.
